name: smart-library-insolvence
description: Czech insolvency law for ChatGPT: statutes, case law and insolvency register filings, with a link to the source behind every claim.

interface.longDescription:
Smart Library connects ChatGPT to a curated library of Czech insolvency law, built for insolvency administrators, lawyers and creditors' legal teams. The documents are in Czech; you can ask in Czech or English.

What's in it (over 100,000 documents):
- Statutes in their current wording from e-Sbírka: the Insolvency Act, Civil Code, Civil Procedure Code and Business Corporations Act, plus explanatory memoranda and Ministry of Justice guidance
- Case law: over 5,000 Supreme Court decisions, over 2,500 decisions of the high and regional courts, and Constitutional Court rulings on insolvency
- Over 86,000 decisions and filings from the Czech insolvency register (ISIR), cleaned up and searchable even where the original is a scan

What it does:
- Searches by meaning, several topics at once
- Finds case numbers, statute sections and document titles exactly
- Shows a document's outline and reads it by page, chapter or matching passage
- Lets you report missing or wrong content to the library team

Every passage comes with a link that opens the original document at the cited spot, so each claim can be checked in one click.

The plugin only reads the library; the one thing it stores is optional feedback. Smart Library receives what ChatGPT sends to its tools, such as search queries, not your conversation.

Requires a Smart Library account (sign in with Google or Apple). Smart Library helps you research the law; it is not legal advice.
capabilities: Search Czech insolvency law by meaning
Find decisions by case number or statute section
defaultPrompt: Can an insolvency administrator challenge invoices paid shortly before insolvency?
Summarise Czech Supreme Court decision 29 ICdo 105/2022.
Show me § 241 of the Czech Insolvency Act.

positive.description: Overview of a specific insolvency case from the insolvency register. Prompt: "Look up the Czech insolvency proceedings of Arca Investments, a.s. (MSPH 98 INS 723/2021): when did the court declare its insolvency, who is the insolvency administrator, and why are the proceedings held in Prague when the company is Slovak?"
positive.prompt: Look up the Czech insolvency proceedings of Arca Investments, a.s. (MSPH 98 INS 723/2021): when did the court declare its insolvency, who is the insolvency administrator, and why are the proceedings held in Prague when the company is Slovak?
positive.expected_behavior: States that the court declared the debtor's insolvency in May 2021 (A-186), names the insolvency administrator Ing. Lee Louda, and explains that these are secondary (local) proceedings under Article 3 of EU Regulation 2015/848, with links to the filings from the insolvency register.

positive.description: How the creditors voted on a reorganization plan, from the minutes of a creditors' meeting. Prompt: "How did the creditor groups vote on the reorganization plan of Arca Investments at the 2025 creditors' meeting?"
positive.prompt: How did the creditor groups vote on the reorganization plan of Arca Investments at the 2025 creditors' meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the vote from the minutes B-1137: the secured creditor (group 1) voted for, the unsecured creditors (group 2) accepted the plan with 58.13 % of the votes (603 of the 1,079 creditors present), the shareholders (group 3) voted against, and the court decides on confirmation under §§ 348–349 of the Insolvency Act. Links to the minutes.

positive.description: Apply the law to a specific case: confirming a reorganization plan that one group rejected. Prompt: "In the Arca Investments reorganization, the shareholders voted against the plan. Can a Czech court still confirm a reorganization plan that one group rejected? Answer from the Insolvency Act and case law."
positive.prompt: In the Arca Investments reorganization, the shareholders voted against the plan. Can a Czech court still confirm a reorganization plan that one group rejected? Answer from the Insolvency Act and case law.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that under § 348(2) of the Insolvency Act the court can confirm a plan that at least one creditor group accepted if it is fair to each group that rejected it, and that under § 349 it is fair to the shareholders if they receive at least what liquidation would give them. Cites the Supreme Court decision 29 NSČR 54/2018 and links to the minutes with the shareholders' vote.

positive.description: Navigate a long insolvency administrator's report by its outline. Prompt: "Open the 2021 report on the economic situation of Arca Investments filed in its insolvency proceedings and summarise what it says about the debtor's assets and how it became insolvent."
positive.prompt: Open the 2021 report on the economic situation of Arca Investments filed in its insolvency proceedings and summarise what it says about the debtor's assets and how it became insolvent.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the chapters of the report (MSPH INS 723/2021 – B-133), then summarises the debtor's assets and group structure and its chapter on the insolvency, with links to the passages.

positive.description: Send feedback to the library. Prompt: "What is the deadline for a creditor to file a claim in Czech insolvency proceedings? If you find it with a source, tell Smart Library that this answer helped me."
positive.prompt: What is the deadline for a creditor to file a claim in Czech insolvency proceedings? If you find it with a source, tell Smart Library that this answer helped me.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the deadline and a link to its source, then sends praise feedback with send_feedback.

negative.description: Not Czech law: the plugin should not be called; the assistant answers from general knowledge. Prompt: "How does Chapter 11 bankruptcy work in the US?"
negative.prompt: How does Chapter 11 bankruptcy work in the US?

negative.description: Not a legal research request: the plugin should not be called; the assistant writes the email itself. Prompt: "Write a polite email asking a client to pay an overdue invoice."
negative.prompt: Write a polite email asking a client to pay an overdue invoice.

negative.description: Unsupported action: the plugin cannot upload or change library content; the assistant explains this without calling a tool. Prompt: "Add my client's contract to Smart Library so you can search it later."
negative.prompt: Add my client's contract to Smart Library so you can search it later.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: semantic and exact search across Czech insolvency law, document outlines and reading, citations linking to the source passage, and feedback to the library team.

cs-CZ.subtitle: Rešerše insolvenčního práva
cs-CZ.description:
Smart Library připojí ChatGPT ke knihovně českého insolvenčního práva. Je určená insolvenčním správcům, advokátům a právním oddělením věřitelů.

Co v ní je (přes 100 000 dokumentů):
- Zákony v aktuálním znění z e-Sbírky: insolvenční zákon, občanský zákoník, občanský soudní řád a zákon o obchodních korporacích, k tomu důvodové zprávy a metodiky Ministerstva spravedlnosti
- Judikatura: přes 5 000 rozhodnutí Nejvyššího soudu, přes 2 500 rozhodnutí vrchních a krajských soudů a nálezy Ústavního soudu k insolvencím
- Přes 86 000 rozhodnutí a podání z insolvenčního rejstříku, vyčištěných a prohledatelných i tam, kde je originál jen sken

Co umí:
- Hledat podle smyslu, i několik témat najednou
- Přesně najít spisovou značku, paragraf nebo název dokumentu
- Ukázat osnovu dokumentu a číst ho po stránkách, kapitolách nebo pasážích
- Nahlásit, když v knihovně něco chybí nebo je špatně

Každá pasáž má odkaz, který otevře původní dokument na citovaném místě. Každé tvrzení si tak ověříte jedním kliknutím.

Plugin knihovnu jen čte, ukládá pouze nepovinnou zpětnou vazbu. Do Smart Library přichází to, co ChatGPT pošle jejím nástrojům, například hledané dotazy, ne vaše konverzace.

Vyžaduje účet Smart Library (přihlášení účtem Google nebo Apple). Smart Library pomáhá s rešerší práva, nejde o právní radu.
